I remember reading somewhere that honesty is really important in a marriage. It builds trust, and without trust, it's hard for a relationship to thrive. I also wonder if there's a way to be honest without causing conflict. Maybe I could explain why I bought the dress and why I thought it was worth the price. If I'm open and honest about my reasoning, maybe he would understand better. I guess it's also important to think about the consequences of my actions. If I lie and he finds out, it could damage our relationship. But if I tell the truth, even if he's upset at first, it might lead to a healthier conversation where we can work things out together.
